rawContent: TODAY’S TAKEAWAYSGRAMMARVOCABULARYPRONUNCIATIONproduct managerif successful: em caso de sucessodelivery: entregadeliver: entregarautomate: automatizarrule – regra - /ru:l/role – papel, posição - /roul/ this successsuccessfulmainfeatureinfrastructurecost: custocoast: costa (sea)1. Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short.Present Perfect: Sarah has cut her hair.Present Simple: Sarah cuts her hair to feel good. Present Continuous: Sarah is cutting her hair at the the beauty / hair salon.Simple Past: Sarah cut her hair yesterday.Past Continuous: Sarah was cutting her hair while her mother was doing her nails.Sarah was cutting her hair when I arrived. Sarah was cutting her hair at 3.00 pm.2. The floor was dirty. Now it is clean.Present Perfect: The floor has been cleaned. – O chão foi limpo (by my sister)My sister has cleaned the floor. – Minha irmã limpou o chão.Present Simple: My sister cleans the floor once a week to help me.Present Continuous: My sister is cleaning the floor today.Past Simple: My sister cleaned the floor last night.Past Continuous: My sister was cleaning the floor when I arrived (at) home. 3. Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work.Present Perfect: Mark has sold his car. Present Simple: Mark sells cars as his job.Every time Mark walks to work he sees interesting cars to buy.Past Continuous: Mark was walking to work when he saw several interesting cars to buy.Present Continuous: Mark is selling cars below market price / at a discount.Past Simple: Mark sold his car two weeks ago.4. The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.Present Perfect: My mother has cooked /baked a cake.5. They are standing outside because they don't have their keys.Present Perfect: They have lost their keys.6. The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.Present Perfect: It has rained.7. I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty.Present Perfect: I have eaten all the food. I have had lunch. 8. The TV is off and the room is quiet.Present Perfect: My dad has slept. My dad has gone to bed.My dad has gone to sleep. 9. James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain.Present Perfect: James has cut his finger.James has hurt his finger.

enriched.title: Present Perfect, Vocabulário e Diferenças de Tempos Verbais
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Perfect em contraste com outros tempos verbais, como Present Simple, Present Continuous, e Past Simple, com exemplos práticos. Além disso, inclui vocabulário relacionado a situações cotidianas e pronúncia de palavras semelhantes.

vocabulary.definition: A person responsible for developing products and ensuring their success in the market.
examples: The product manager is preparing a new strategy for the launch.

vocabulary.definition: Used to describe a condition where success is achieved.
examples: If successful, the project will bring great benefits.

vocabulary.definition: The act of bringing goods or services to someone.
examples: The delivery of the package was delayed.

vocabulary.definition: To bring something to a person or place.
examples: The courier will deliver the package tomorrow.

vocabulary.definition: To make a process operate automatically.
examples: The company plans to automate its production line.

vocabulary.definition: A statement that specifies what is allowed or prohibited.
examples: You must follow the rules of the game.

vocabulary.definition: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or organization.
examples: He played a significant role in the success of the project.

vocabulary.definition: A distinctive attribute or aspect of something.
examples: This app has many advanced features.

vocabulary.definition: The basic physical and organizational structures needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.
examples: The city is investing in infrastructure to improve transportation.

vocabulary.definition: The amount of money needed to buy or do something.
examples: The cost of living has increased significantly.

vocabulary.definition: The land next to or near the sea.
examples: They spent the weekend on the coast.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions or events that happened at an unspecified time in the past or that have relevance to the present.
rules: Used for actions with a connection to the present.
commonMistakes: Using Present Perfect with specific time expressions like 'yesterday'.
Confusing it with Simple Past for actions completed in the past.

grammar.explanation: Describes actions that were in progress at a specific moment in the past.
rules: Often used with another action in Simple Past.
examples: Sarah was cutting her hair when I arrived.
My sister was cleaning the floor when I arrived home.
commonMistakes: Using the base form of the verb instead of the '-ing' form.
Using it for actions that are not continuous.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Sarah ______ her hair. (Present Perfect)
practiceQuestions.explanation: Present Perfect is formed with 'has' + past participle.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct form: My sister ______ the floor when I arrived. (Past Continuous)
practiceQuestions.explanation: Past Continuous is formed with 'was' + verb-ing.

studyTips: Practice converting sentences between different tenses to understand their differences.
Pay attention to time markers like 'yesterday' or 'already' to choose the correct tense.
originalExamples: Sarah has cut her hair. (Sarah cortou o cabelo.)
My sister has cleaned the floor. (Minha irmã limpou o chão.)
Mark has sold his car. (Mark vendeu seu carro.)
My sister was cleaning the floor when I arrived home. (Minha irmã estava limpando o chão quando cheguei em casa.)
I have eaten all the food. (Eu comi toda a comida.)
James has cut his finger. (James cortou o dedo.)
